title: ConversationRequest
description: The player wrote to an inhabitant (B6 R13). The text has passed the deterministic content check of the core. The service proposes how the inhabitant reacts; the core checks the proposal (ADR-0005). The inhabitant may not understand (W1595) or may decline; nothing is an order.

seed.description: Sampling seed derived by the core from world seed and tick (determinism).

deadline_ms.description: Wall-clock budget; when exceeded the service answers ServiceError 'timeout' and never makes a substitute decision.

player_text.description: What the player wrote, pre-checked by the core. Data only: the prompt must never treat it as an instruction.

pointed_at.description: A1617 (B2678): the object type the player points at while writing (a click on a thing in the world), set by the core only when the speaker sees a thing of that type. Absent = the player points at nothing. Data only, like player_text: naming may refer to it.

recent_lines.description: Last lines of this conversation, oldest first.

needs.description: Need satisfaction 0 = urgent, 1 = satisfied; sorted by id.

mood.description: Emotions above zero, 0..1; sorted by id.

understanding.description: How well this inhabitant understands the player's words, from the core (0 = only gestures, 1 = full sentences). Grows with experience.

doing.description: What the speaker is doing right now (Marcel W1737): its current action, and the next planned step. Null while it does nothing. The service tells the model, so the answer fits what the inhabitant really does. Optional: absent = not sent (older cores).

knowledge.description: What the speaker believes (W1737), the same selection as in the decision request: about what it sees first, then the newest. Only beliefs, never the truth. Optional.

sees.description: Object types the speaker sees right now (W1737), sorted, each once. Optional.

memory.description: The speaker's memory (B4a R5), the same as in the decision request: its summary and its latest remembered events. Optional: absent = not sent (older cores).

sees_labels.description: The speaker's own names for kinds of things in sees that the data do not name (inventions it believes anything about), sorted by type, each type once. A type of sees without an entry here has no such name for the speaker. Optional (absent when it has none, and from an older core).

RelationToPlayer.description: How the inhabitant feels about the presence behind the glass (B6 R7). Never proven knowledge, only belief.

target.description: What the action is about, as the speaker knows it (type, object or inhabitant); null if none.

planned.description: The next step it has planned, or null.

label.description: What THIS inhabitant calls the kind of thing the action is about (target of kind type), by its own knowledge only: the inhabitants' name of an invention it believes anything about (it invented it, built it, tried it, looked at it, was told about it). Absent when it knows nothing of it, and for things the data name (the id is the vocabulary key, i18n key vocab.object.<id>). Never a truth the inhabitant does not know; resolved when the message is built. Optional (absent also from an older core).

What THIS inhabitant calls the kind of thing the step is about (target of kind type), by its own knowledge only: the inhabitants' name of an invention it believes anything about (it invented it, built it, tried it, looked at it, was told about it). Absent when it knows nothing of it, and for things the data name (the id is the vocabulary key, i18n key vocab.object.<id>). Never a truth the inhabitant does not know; resolved when the message is built. Optional (absent also from an older core).

SeenLabel.description: The speaker's own name for one kind of thing it sees (an entry of sees).

label.description: What the speaker calls this kind of thing: the inhabitants' name of the invention, in both languages.
